name: lci_identity
description: LCI /config/identity CBOR vectors (spec 17.5.2): read-only identity documents emitted by IdentityConfigResource. Addresses derive from the node Ed25519 key per spec 6.1/12 (link-local fe80::/10 + native 0200::/8). The resource has no write path: mutating methods yield 4.05.

vectors.name: get_full_identity
vectors.description: GET /config/identity with all fields; addresses are genuinely derived from the Ed25519 public key (seed 000102..1f) via link_local_from_pubkey and native_address_from_pubkey.

vectors.name: get_minimal_identity
vectors.description: Identity exposing only the long address.

vectors.name: get_addrs_only
vectors.description: Identity exposing only the derived address map (no EUI-64).

vectors.name: get_unprovisioned_identity
vectors.description: Edge: unprovisioned node returns an empty CBOR identity map.

vectors.name: put_read_only_method_not_allowed
vectors.description: Identity is read-only: PUT returns 4.05 Method Not Allowed.

vectors.name: delete_read_only_method_not_allowed
vectors.description: DELETE on the read-only identity resource returns 4.05.
